title: Scoped negative result: three-mode P112 COPY64 despite four span-loss exceptions
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Scoped negative result; no new kappa.** Mixing any three P112 coordinate terms with one nonzero free rank-one correction by arbitrary `GL(4,C)` cannot lower the separate COPY bill below 64 when both correction supports have at least two indices. At least three replacement terms have COPY rank at least eight; the separate power bill cannot improve for `0<q<=1`.

The two-mode span lemma from #1473 fails in exactly four representative three-mode cases, each a 24-by-2 rectangle. This package classifies those exceptions and proves the COPY floor using their surviving pairing ranks. Identity mixing attains 64; the explicit cancellation costs 70 after compensation. The proof covers all 56 coordinate triples through verified symmetries.

Only `research/p112-three-mode-seed40/` is added. Singleton-sided corrections, more mixed modes, multiple corrections and shared COPY billing remain outside scope. No physical supplier, complete recurrence, compiler/hosting/precision admission or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. OS assignment seed **40**, structural decoder research; `complex-masked-decoder` card, **refined** scope. TASK/CLAIM record three candidates, the seed-selected triple `(2,4,5)`, exact domain and stopping rule.

Nearest predecessor: #1473 at `ea2f6bf0940580dfaeb393ec0786abc8f7bbb7b4`, which explicitly leaves three-mode support classification open. The additional evidence is the 39-stratum classification, four counterexamples to extending its span lemma, and the repaired four-term bound. #1432, #1460 and #1468 concern two-mode corrections; #1325 retains fixed readers. No pending theorem is imported.

The complete overlap refresh covered 756 open PRs and 191 discussions with no warnings; the nearest head and latest PRs were rechecked. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim is local. Exact Git blobs/SHA256 pins and overlap limits are included. Main and all pinned inputs remained unchanged on refresh.

## Validation

Python 3.12.13, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-three-mode-seed40
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p112-three-mode-seed40 outcome=negative-result`.

Local registered replay passes: 19,926 character-support cuts; six Gaussian-rational fixtures / 75,264 entries; eight controls. A code-disjoint checker independently constructs Euclidean roots and rational flats, checks all 242,424 support/erasure cases, 96 single-row restorations and 702,464 transport pairing entries, and verifies integer compensation.

Six external corruption tests, 20 research workflow tests, selected-record integrity and baseline bindings pass. Both checkers also pass in a read-only relocated export under Python 3.14.6 with `-I -O -B`; all 13 file hashes remain unchanged. Finite premises support a written quantified proof, not proof-assistant formalization or independent human review. Selected cold replay, new native admission and hosted-CI success are not claimed.

Prepared for **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex** assistance in mathematics, both implementations, verification and writing. The two implementations share the same AI-assisted author. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

README/TASK identify singleton-sided three-mode corrections and four-mode mixing. Each first requires a new erasure/support classification and a coupled compensation bound; neither follows by rerunning this excluded class. Physical costs remain an additional obligation for any positive construction.
